name: skyhook-io/radar
title: skyhook-io/radar
headline: Radar: Kubernetes UI with built-in MCP server
lede: You can let AI agents inspect cluster issues, topology, events and audits through an MCP server in one Go binary.

effects.effect: Ops tools ship MCP servers by default

appearances.title: skyhook-io/radar
appearances.summary: The missing open-source Kubernetes UI with a built-in MCP server for AI agents. See what's broken, why, and what changed. Issues, Topology, event timeline, Helm, GitOps, live service traffic, and cluster audits - all in one Go binary.
